status: research shortlist; unreviewed and not benchmark gold
provenance: Convenience sample of public forum questions, a teaching exercise, and bank/regulator FAQs. The source wording or scenario is distinguished from any CDM-specific adaptation. Candidates were selected and mapped by the assistant after seeing existing benchmark results; they are not a representative random sample, an independent test set, or independently reviewed relevance judgments.
